jobs.name: Triện Thiên Môn
jobs.description: FRONT VIEW upright hollow SQUARE bronze ritual seal in a circular ivory rim. Four angular corners click inward like an ancient stamp machine, crimson threads cinch them and a small bright ivory diamond ignites centrally. Six ordered stages: two corner fragments / four corners converge / ring appears / dense square lattice locks / pressure brightens / complete focused square seal. Clearly legible strong silhouette, thin clear center, not a speck of swirling smoke. Origin at geometric center.

jobs.name: Đạo Ấn · Phán Quyết
jobs.description: SCREEN RIGHT traveling sharp rectangular SEAL SPEAR. A large luminous ivory-bronze diamond stamp head thrusts right with three aligned dark obsidian square lattice plates stacked behind it, red-hot vermilion energy through their centers and sharp tapering trailing strokes to LEFT. Strong contrast ivory core / near-black ink border / crimson seam. Six stages: spear birth / stamp head advances / fully articulated powerful lance / lattice plates shatter behind / shrinking broken red path / last stamp fragments. Tip direction always RIGHT. No round fireball, generic ribbon or broad filled fog. All six effect origins at center of their cell.

jobs.name: Phân Phù · Ly Ảnh
jobs.description: An upright hollow talisman EYE/DIAMOND made from two mirrored folded ivory paper brackets, red silk-like threads and a charcoal hollow center. It splits and recombines with three floating narrow paper talismans. Six ordered formation stages: single folded plate / opposing brackets / diamond frame / split plates / two interlocking eyes / three crisp folded talismans poised around one bright diamond. An eerie paper ritual with angular readable shapes, no drawn people or faces, no actual eye illustration. Center fixed.

jobs.name: Phân Phù · Tam Phù
jobs.description: SCREEN RIGHT traveling fan of THREE folded talisman blades, center blade largest with ivory angular diamond tip, two smaller papery blades alongside it slightly staggered above/below. Split charcoal-paper shadows and thin vermilion strings behind them, bright aged-gold folded edges. Six stages: folded blades gather / fan opens / three razor seals fully visible / paper tips split / torn fragments / sparse red and ivory paper chips. Distinct origami-paper silhouette, not the seal spear or a generic trail. Consistent right-facing and cell-center origins, clear gaps between blades.

jobs.name: Ấn Hồi · Lập Trận
jobs.description: STRICT TOP DOWN ground ritual annular sector: a240-degree C-shaped array of SIX large broken ivory square seal tablets set around a near-black thin ring with gold hard edge and vermilion winding threads. Completely EMPTY90degree rear opening centered SCREEN LEFT in ALL six frames, including threads/sparks. Transparent center, ring only. Six assembly stages with full-radius guide rim: faint broken corner tablets / three aligned seals / six seals / tablets light in sequence / crimson inner arcs tighten / all six tablets hold bright pressure. Full physical ring diameter same between frames1-6; each formation has some faint ring silhouette to hold origin. Fixed center; not perspective ellipse, upright halo or opaque disk.

originWitnesses.method: Median circle-center residual of high-alpha charcoal ring pixels in first three source cells; one offset for entire sequence, never recenter each frame.

jobs.name: Ấn Hồi · Lục Triện Quy Tâm
jobs.description: STRICT TOP DOWN 270-degree C-shaped contracting ritual ring with SIX large luminous ivory square seals, sharp bronze lattice and near-black hard outline. Thin crimson energy pulls inward, converging like a restrained whirlpool around a TRANSPARENT EMPTY CENTER. Completely EMPTY90degree escape wedge SCREEN LEFT remains empty in ALL six stages. Six frames: full-radius seals ignite / thin inward hook arcs appear / six seals snap and pull toward center / broken seal tablets gather closer / red lines and ivory chips unravel / faint disappearing C outline and chips. Peak ring diameter unchanged frame1-3 then contracts; no opaque dark smoke cloud, no filled disk, no flame wall. Fixed center of effect; ground plane view.

originWitnesses.method: Median circle-center residual of high-alpha charcoal ring pixels in first three source cells; one offset for entire sequence, never recenter each frame.

jobs.name: Triện Vỡ · Xác Nhận
jobs.description: A forceful square STAMP CONTACT fractures on impact. Bright ivory diamond imprint bordered in near-black and bronze appears and cracks into four angular corners with vermilion rays. Six ordered stages: sharp small stamp flash / complete square mark / pressure fracture peak / ivory-bronze corner shards eject / shattered red seams fade / last paper-like chips. Crisp moment of contact, compact hollow center after peak, no blood/people, no giant circular explosion or full opaque white disk. Geometric center same for all frames.

jobs.name: Hư Ảnh · Phù Tàn
jobs.description: A tall open arch made from THREE floating ivory paper talismans collapses into torn-paper fragments, a hollow dark crimson diamond seal and long thin charcoal ink strings. Six stages: intact narrow hovering paper gate / paper brackets separate / burst of folded ivory corners / torn ribbons fall apart / few red threads and ivory flakes / last motes. Ritual illusion dissolution, distinctly softer/sparser than a damage impact. Do NOT draw an actor, body, face, ghost or weapon. Clear transparent center throughout, consistent center origins.
